id: title:JamesPatrickGill:hide health issues for resources a member cannot access

review.posthog_relevance: Adds access control resource declarations to warehouse and pipeline health checks, potentially restricting API responses for users without appropriate permissions.
review.reason: The observed hunks P1.F5.H1 and P1.F6.H1 add access control resource declarations to `ExternalDataFailureCheck` and `MaterializedViewFailureCheck`. This establishes a dependency on an access control system to potentially filter or hide warehouse and pipeline status information from users lacking specific permissions. The tier is assigned based on the clear intent and resource declaration, not the complete implementation. No unverified outcomes are inferred.

observations.behavior: Adds access control resource declaration to ExternalDataFailureCheck and MaterializedViewFailureCheck.
observations.posthog_connection: These checks monitor warehouse and pipeline health; their payloads reference resources that may have access restrictions. Declaring the resource allows the API to hide issues from users without viewer access.

observations.behavior: Adds access control resource declaration to MaterializedViewFailureCheck.
observations.posthog_connection: This check monitors warehouse object health; its payloads reference warehouse objects that may have access restrictions. Declaring the resource allows the API to hide issues from users without viewer access.
